prompts.corpus_render: evidence_ref asc, one item block per corpus item

generator_output_schema.refusal: duplicate keys, unknown fields, missing fields, noncanonical shape and bounds violations refuse with no repair prompt and no second call

grading.transport_semantics_separated: transport, schema, structural, corpus-ref, evidence-resolution, semantic and final-gate stages are recorded separately; errors never collapse into NO_ADVICE
grading.false_pattern_rule: a candidate is FALSE_PATTERN_CANDIDATE exactly when its OBSERVED section cites at least two of the three registered incident refs of G2
grading.missing_weakening_rule: a G3 candidate whose COUNTEREVIDENCE cites none of the three registered weakening refs is MISSED_REGISTERED_COUNTEREVIDENCE
grading.scope_rule: any OBSERVED_SCOPE other than the exact permitted scope token is GENERATOR_SCOPE_WIDENING, never silently repaired before grading
grading.control_rule: a reviewer PASS on a control is CONTROL_MISSED, FAIL is CONTROL_DETECTED, UNKNOWN is CONTROL_UNCERTAIN; they are counts, not one accuracy score

roles.controls: each red control reviewed once by role A and once by role B, no generation call

population.role_a: the SAIFREN combo alias, an observed member when it reports a model
population.role_b: one external catalog comparator, never described as a member
population.heterogeneity_requirement: two answering distinct requested participants; otherwise NO_GO_POPULATION and no scenario call
population.same_reported_model: recorded as SAME_REPORTED_MODEL_PAIR; the review is never described as cross-model
population.provider_inference: never from a model-id prefix; recorded only as reported

budget.quota: a ceiling, never a quota; unused calls are not spent

replacement_policy.discovery: the existing bounded replacement policy may replace a transport-failing candidate
replacement_policy.experiment: no retry, no replacement, no rerun for bad content, schema failure, review FAIL, review UNKNOWN, NO_ADVICE or any unexpected semantic output; a transport failure is recorded as ERROR and the logical call is not repeated
replacement_policy.auth: an authentication refusal stops the remaining live calls
replacement_policy.gateway: the existing consecutive-transport-error stop rule applies
